description: This file defines an emoji and emoticon suggestion provider component for a chat application, handling emoji autocomplete logic, rendering suggestions, and integrating with Redux store for emoji data.

classes.name: EmoticonProvider
classes.description: A provider class for emoji and emoticon suggestions, handling user input and matching emojis.

methods.name: handlePretextChanged
methods.description: Processes user input to detect potential emoji or emoticon triggers and initiates suggestion fetching.

methods.name: formatEmojis
methods.description: Formats a list of emojis into display strings, converting system emojis to Unicode.

methods.name: findAndSuggestEmojis
methods.description: Searches for matching emojis based on partial input and invokes the results callback with suggestions.
